protocol.sr_diagnosis: GT read only AFTER actions/continuation. At clean stages global16(s309),24(t119),29(t0), and final output, log raw/clamped MSE, clamp fraction, exact db4 error energy contributions LL3/details and observed clean measurement MSE. protocol.hypotheses: SR worse only at long lengths suggests amplitude contribution; worse at matched short length suggests direction contribution. Lower measured-domain error with worse detail/full error suggests objective/whole-image mismatch. First-clean gain followed by later regression suggests continuation interaction. These paired diagnostics distinguish contributions, not unique universal causes.
protocol.qualification: All same-state interventions, fixed factorial, no residual-based policy rescue. Per-task directional gain requires +.1dB,>=2/3 wins,SSIM nondecrease,LPIPS nonincrease at matched length; report mixed results and interaction.
